reasoning: Literally the standard photography glyph for center-weighted average metering (a circle between two parentheses inside a viewfinder frame), which general users also read as a wall-mounted motion sensor or wireless broadcasting screen. It fits specific photography, smart-home sensor, or streaming tasks, though at small sizes it can be confused with a banknote or generic Wi-Fi hotspot icon.
